newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lands' End EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lands' End EPS view up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its earnings estimates for retailer Lands' End Inc to $1.39 a share from $1.25 for the fiscal year ending in January 1997.
-- It also raised its estimate to $1.64 a share from $1.50 for the fiscal year ending in January 1998.

-- Earlier this week, Lands' End reported third quarter earings of $0.19 a share, compared with $0.05 a year ago. Revenues were up 21.8 percent, which EVEREN said was the best showing since the January 1994 quarter.

-- "While one quarter doesn't make a trend, the improvements in design and merchandise and what we believe is a more productive mailing strategy will likely be sustainable into FY January 1998," EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said it raised its six-month price target to $27 a share from $24, and its 18-month target to $33 from $29.
-- Lands' End shares on Friday were up 1/8 at 25 in midmorning exchange trading.
